findings.message: Redaction is narrowed from replacing every value to only exact-match keys in SENSITIVE_FIELDS; any other key (e.g. api_key, secret, access_token, private_key) now passes through unredacted, and listed fields with different casing/spacing (e.g. 'Authorization', 'ACCESS_TOKEN', 'access_token' vs 'token') are not matched because the comparison is exact and case-sensitive.
findings.suggestion: Normalize keys before matching (strip().lower()) and use a set; consider redacting by suffix/substring match or defaulting to full redaction with an explicit allowlist of non-sensitive fields instead of a denylist of sensitive ones.
